title: VPC connectivity in one screen
rememberThis: Gateway endpoints = S3 and DynamoDB (route table, free). Interface endpoints = ENI + SG for other AWS services.
VPC peering is pairwise and not transitive — use Transit Gateway for hub-and-spoke at scale.
Site-to-Site VPN is IPsec over the internet; Direct Connect is a private circuit — combine for HA.
PrivateLink exposes a service via NLB, not an entire VPC CIDR.
Hybrid reference: DX primary + VPN backup → TGW route domains → VPC endpoints for AWS APIs.
bullets: Interface endpoints need tcp/443 security group rules and optional private DNS.
TGW route table association controls which spokes see each other — not automatic full mesh.
Cross-Region peering and TGW peering add latency and separate DNS considerations.
Endpoint policies restrict API/resource scope in addition to IAM.
Prove connectivity with Flow Logs, BGP tables, and search-transit-gateway-routes.
